verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a TypeScript authentication and authorization framework. Scheduling recurring user jobs or workflows falls outside that product category, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships a job scheduler. Time-based behaviors such as session expiry, rate-limit windows and API-key refill systems are auth mechanics, not user-schedulable recurring workflows, so they do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
